summary: Ameren Corporation filed a Form 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing Item 2.02 results of operations for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2026, alongside Item 8.01 disclosure of unaudited consolidated financial statements and Item 9.01 exhibits. The release covers Q3 2026 GAAP diluted earnings and includes statements of income, balance sheet, and cash flows for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 versus prior-year periods. No transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or ownership changes are disclosed. This is a routine earnings current report, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
